div.div: 2 In-cluster DNS A CoreDNS replica on every node plus internalTrafficPolicy: Local, so each pod resolves through the CoreDNS running on its own node instead of a replica in the Region.

div.div: 3 Local image availability Critical images pre-pulled on every node that may run the workload, with containerd image garbage collection prevented from discarding unpacked layers.

div.div: 4 Local traffic entry point A Layer 2 load balancer on-premises, with tolerations on its speaker, so ingress and its health checks make their failover decision without the Region.
